items.title: Frank Tiberi interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, May 30, 2022
items.q: J. Monterose was on the other end of the saxophones so he had all great players

ctx.x: He had a lot — J. Monterose was on the other end of the saxophones so he had all great players — Doug Mettome — I don’t know whether you know him.
I have heard that name, yes.
